## Load packages and functions

```{r}
source("aux_functions.R")
```

## Load data

```{r}
phy_table_pico_raw <- readRDS("../data/phyloseq/EukEMM_v3.2_DCM_pico.rds")
phy_table_photo_raw <- readRDS("../data/phyloseq/EukEMM_v3.2_DCM_phototrophs.rds")
phy_table_phago_raw <- readRDS("../data/phyloseq/EukEMM_v3.2_DCM_phagotrophs.rds")

clusters_metadata <-
  read_tsv("../data/metadata/clusters_metadata.tsv") |>
  mutate(
    profile_abb = factor(profile_abb, levels = c("RD1", "RD2", "RD3", "RD4", "MD", "MM", "MS", "MD2", "P04", "P08", "P10", "P11", "P18", "P26"))
  ) |>
  arrange(profile_abb)

fluorescence_data_clustering <- 
  read_tsv("../data/metadata/fluorescence.tsv") 

outgroups <- 
  read_tsv('../data/metadata/outgroups.tsv')

trees_parameters <- 
  read_tsv('../data/metadata/trees_parameters.tsv') |> 
  group_by(Group) |> 
  summarise(
    parameters = list(pick(xlim1, xlim2)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  deframe()

tree_files <- 
  order_trees |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ read.tree(str_c('../data/trees/trees/',.x,'.treefile'))
  )

metadata_dcm <- 
  read_tsv('../data/metadata/metadata_dcms.tsv')

temperature_dcm <- 
  read_tsv('../data/metadata/dcm_temperature.tsv')

fluorescence_env_variables <- 
  read_tsv('../data/metadata/fluorescence_fig2.tsv')

samples_metadata <- 
  read_tsv("../data/metadata/samples_metadata.tsv") |> 
  mutate(profile_abb = fct_inorder(profile_abb))
```

## Process data

### Environmental data

```{r}
profiles <- 
  levels(samples_metadata$profile_abb)

metadata_dcm_filtered <- 
  metadata_dcm |> 
  select(profile_abb = profile_id, Depth, Nitrate, `Peuk 1`, `Peuk 2`, Nanoeuk) |> 
  rename_with(.cols = everything(), ~ str_replace(tolower(.x),' ','_')) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(peuk = if_else(!is.na(peuk_1), sum(peuk_1, peuk_2, na.rm = T), NA),
         peuk = peuk/100,
         nanoeuk = nanoeuk/100) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(profile_abb = factor(profile_abb, levels = profiles))

metadata_dcm_tidy <- 
  metadata_dcm_filtered |> 
  select(-c(contains('Peuk_'))) |> 
  pivot_longer(-c(profile_abb, depth)) |> 
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c('nitrate','peuk', 'nanoeuk')))

temperature_dcm_df <- 
  temperature_dcm |> 
  mutate(profile_abb = factor(profile_id, levels = levels(profiles)))

nitrate_values <- 
  profiles |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ metadata_dcm_tidy |>
      filter(profile_abb == .x,
             name == 'nitrate') |> 
      select(depth, nitrate = value)
  )

temperature_values <- 
  profiles |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ temperature_dcm_df |>
      filter(profile_abb == .x) |> 
      select(depth, temperature = value)
  )

fluorescence_values <- 
  profiles |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ fluorescence_env_variables |>
      filter(profile_abb == .x) |> 
      select(depth = Depth, fluorescence = Smoothed_Fluorescence)
  )  

sampling_values <- 
  profiles |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ samples_metadata |> 
      filter(profile_abb == .x) |> 
      left_join(
        fluorescence_values[[.x]] |> 
          group_by(depth) |> 
          slice_head(n = 1),
        by = join_by(closest(depth <= depth))) |> 
      select(-depth.x) |> 
      dplyr::rename(depth = depth.y)
  )

peuk_values <- 
  profiles |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ metadata_dcm_tidy |>
      filter(profile_abb == .x,
             name == 'peuk') |> 
      select(depth, peuk = value)
  )

neuk_values <- 
  profiles |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ metadata_dcm_tidy |>
      filter(profile_abb == .x,
             name == 'nanoeuk') |> 
      select(depth, neuk = value)
  )
```


### Phyloseq objects

```{r}
phy_table_pico <-
  phy_table_pico_raw

phy_table_photo <-
  phy_table_photo_raw

phy_table_phago <-
  phy_table_phago_raw

new_metadata <-
  sample_data(phy_table_pico_raw) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    St =
      case_when(
        Project == "MIAU Catalan Sea" ~ str_c(Station, "_MIAU"),
        Project == "POSEIDON Atlantic" & nchar(Station) == 2 ~ str_c(Station, "_POSEIDON"),
        Project == "POSEIDON Atlantic" & nchar(Station) == 1 ~ str_c("0", Station, "_POSEIDON"),
        Project == "REMEI Catalan Sea" & Lat %in% c("41.0358", "40.8333") ~ "D1_REMEI",
        Project == "REMEI Catalan Sea" & Lat == "40.8386" ~ "D2_REMEI",
        Project == "REMEI Catalan Sea" & Lat == "41.0692" ~ "D3_REMEI",
        Project == "REMEI Catalan Sea" & Lat == "41.0719" ~ "D4_REMEI"
      )
  ) |>
  sample_data()

sample_data(phy_table_pico) <- new_metadata
sample_data(phy_table_photo) <- new_metadata
sample_data(phy_table_phago) <- new_metadata

phy_tables <-
  c(phy_table_pico, phy_table_photo, phy_table_phago) |>
  set_names(c("pico", "photo", "phago"))

profile_names <-
  phy_table_pico |>
  sample_data() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  pull(St) |>
  unique()

clusters_per_profile <-
  c("pico", "photo", "phago") |>
  set_names() |>
  map(
    ~ clusters_metadata |>
      filter(trophic == .x) |>
      select(profile, nclusters) |>
      deframe()
  )

cluster_names <-
  c("pico", "photo", "phago") |>
  set_names() |>
  map(
    ~ clusters_metadata |>
      filter(trophic == .x) |>
      pivot_longer(names_to = "cluster_name", values_to = "cluster", c(Surface, contains("Above"), DCM, Below, Deep)) |>
      mutate(
        cluster = as.character(cluster),
        cluster_name = factor(cluster_name, levels = c("Surface", "Above1", "Above2", "DCM", "Below", "Deep"))
      ) |>
      select(profile, profile_abb, cluster_name, cluster)
  )

profiles_abb <-
  clusters_metadata |>
  distinct(profile_abb, profile)

metadata_df <-
  phy_tables$pico |>
  sample_data() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(sample = .sample, depth = Depth, profile = St) |>
  left_join(profiles_abb)
```
### Fluorescence data

```{r}
fluorescence_smoothed <-
  fluorescence_data_clustering |>
  filter(Depth < 210) |> 
  mutate(smoothed_fluorescence = Smoothed_Fluorescence * 100) |> 
  mutate(smoothed_fluorescence = if_else(DCM_type == '11_POSEIDON' & Depth > 200, NA_real_, smoothed_fluorescence)) |> 
  select(profile = DCM_type, depth = Depth, smoothed_fluorescence) |>
  left_join(profiles_abb) |> 
  filter(!is.na(smoothed_fluorescence))

base_plot_fluorescence <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_area(
    data = fluorescence_smoothed,
    aes(y = depth, x = smoothed_fluorescence),
    fill = "grey65", alpha = 0.5, stat = "identity", position = "identity", orientation = "y"
  )
```

### Fuzzy clustering

#### Clustering

```{r}
clusters_df <-
  phy_tables |>
  imap(
    ~ clusterer_and_plotter_occur(
      n_clusters = clusters_per_profile[[.y]],
      phy_table = .x,
      get_clusters_long = T,
      min_occur = 1,
      cluster_names = cluster_names[[.y]]
    )
  )
```

#### Summaries

```{r}
cluster_summaries <-
  clusters_df |>
  map(
    ~ .x |>
      filter(!is.na(cluster_name)) |>
      mutate(
        cluster_name =
          case_when(
            str_detect(cluster_name, "Above") ~ str_remove(cluster_name, "[12]"), # unify duplicated layers into one
            TRUE ~ cluster_name
          ),
        cluster_name = factor(cluster_name, levels = c("Surface", "Above", "DCM", "Below", "Deep"))
      ) |>
      group_by(profile_abb, Group, Supergroup, cluster_name) |>
      summarise(perc = sum(perc), .groups = "drop") |>
      group_by(profile_abb, cluster_name) |>
      mutate(perc = 100 * perc / sum(perc)) |>
      mutate(
        layer =
          case_when(
            cluster_name == "Above" ~ "Upper",
            cluster_name == "Below" ~ "Lower",
            TRUE ~ cluster_name
          ),
        layer = factor(layer, levels = c("Surface", "Upper", "DCM", "Inter", "Lower", "Deep"))
      )
  )

cluster_summaries_all <- 
  cluster_summaries |>
  map(
    ~ .x |> 
      ungroup() |> 
      filter(layer %in% c('Surface', 'DCM', 'Deep')) |>
      select(-cluster_name) |> 
      group_by(layer, Group) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = c(profile_abb, layer), values_from = perc, values_fill = 0) |> # strange way to complete missing values
      pivot_longer(-c(Group, Supergroup), values_to = 'perc') |> 
      separate(name, into = c('profile_abb', 'layer'), sep = '_') |> 
      mutate(profile_abb = factor(profile_abb, levels = levels(profiles)),
             layer = factor(layer, levels = c("Surface", "Upper", "DCM", "Inter", "Lower", "Deep"))) |> 
      group_by(Group, layer) |> 
      summarise(mean_perc = mean(perc), .groups = "drop_last")
  ) 

cluster_summaries_to_export <- 
  cluster_summaries |> 
  imap(
     ~ .x |> 
       ungroup() |> 
       select(-cluster_name) |> 
       arrange(layer) |> 
       pivot_wider(names_from = c(profile_abb, layer), values_from = perc, values_fill = 0) |> 
       left_join(
         cluster_summaries_all[[.y]] |> 
           pivot_wider(names_from = layer, values_from = mean_perc, values_fill = 0)
       ) |> 
       left_join( # include totals
         cluster_summaries_all[[.y]] |> 
           group_by(Group) |> 
           summarise(total_perc = sum(mean_perc))
       ) |> 
       arrange(-total_perc)
  )

asv_summaries <- 
  c('photo','phago') |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ clusters_df[[.x]] |> 
      select(-profile_abb) |> 
      left_join(profiles_abb) |>
      mutate(
        cluster =
          case_when(
            str_detect(cluster_name, "Deep|Above") ~ str_remove(cluster_name, "[12]"), # unify duplicated layers into one
            is.na(cluster_name) ~ cluster,
            TRUE ~ cluster_name
          )
      ) |>  
      distinct(asv_id, Group, Supergroup, profile_abb, cluster) |> 
      arrange(profile_abb) |> 
      pivot_wider(names_from = profile_abb, values_from = cluster, values_fill = 'absent')
  )

clusters_per_asv <- 
  asv_summaries |> 
  map(
    ~ .x |> 
      pivot_longer(names_to = 'profile_abb', values_to = 'cluster', -c(asv_id, Group, Supergroup)) |> 
      filter(!cluster %in% c('low_abundance','absent')) |> 
      count(asv_id, Group, Supergroup, name = 'nclusters')
  )

asv_mean_abundance_and_occur <- 
  phy_tables |> 
  map(
    ~ {
      taxa_sums(transform_sample_counts(physeq = .x, fun = percentage)) |> 
        as_tibble(rownames = 'asv_id') |> 
        mutate(mean_perc = value/154) |> # divide by num of samples
        left_join(
          rowSums(otu_table(.x) > 0) |> 
            as_tibble(rownames = 'asv_id') |> 
            dplyr::rename(occur = value)
        ) |> 
        left_join(
          tax_table(.x) |> as_tibble() |> select(asv_id = .otu, Group, ASV)
        )
    } 
  ) |> 
  bind_rows(.id = 'trophic') |> 
  select(-value) |> 
  arrange(-mean_perc)
```



### Trees

#### Associated data

```{r}
asvs_for_tree <- # apply a threshold of minimum 4 clusters
  clusters_per_asv |> 
  bind_rows(.id = 'trophic') |> 
  filter(nclusters >= 4,
         Group %in% order_trees) |> 
  left_join(
    tax_table(phy_table_pico) |> 
      as_tibble() |> 
      select(asv_id = .otu, ASV, subclade = Taxon_second_rank)
  ) |> 
  left_join(
    asv_mean_abundance_and_occur |> select(-c(Group, ASV))
  ) |> 
  filter(
    subclade != 'Chimera' | is.na(subclade)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    name = 
      if_else(
        is.na(subclade),
        str_c(asv_id, Group, round(mean_perc,2), occur, sep = '_'),
        str_c(asv_id, subclade, round(mean_perc,2), occur, sep = '_')
        )
  )

asv_data_for_trees <- 
  asv_summaries |> 
  map(
    ~ .x |> 
      pivot_longer(names_to = 'profile_abb', values_to = 'cluster', -c(asv_id, Group, Supergroup)) |> 
      filter(!cluster %in% c('low_abundance','absent', 'low_membership')) |> 
      mutate(
        cluster2 =
          case_when(
            cluster == 'Above' ~ 'Surface',
            cluster == 'Below' ~ 'Deep',
            TRUE ~ cluster
          )
      ) |> 
      count(asv_id, cluster2) |>
      group_by(asv_id) |> 
      mutate(
        perc = 100*n/sum(n),
        total_profiles = sum(n)
        ) |> 
      mutate(perc2 = 100*n / 14) |>  # total percentage divided by the 14 profiles
      filter(asv_id %in% asvs_for_tree$asv_id) |> 
      left_join(asvs_for_tree |> select(asv_id, Group, label = name))
  ) |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  mutate(cluster2 = factor(cluster2, levels = c('Surface','DCM','Deep')))

nprofiles_per_biome <- 
  asv_summaries |> 
  map(
    ~ .x |> 
      pivot_longer(names_to = 'profile_abb', values_to = 'cluster', -c(asv_id, Group, Supergroup)) |> 
      filter(!cluster %in% c('low_abundance','absent')) |> 
      mutate(biome = 
               case_when(
                 cluster == 'low_membership' ~ 'Not clustered',
                 str_detect(profile_abb, '^P') ~ 'Atlantic', 
                 !str_detect(profile_abb, '^P') ~ 'Mediterranean'
               )
             ) |> 
      count(asv_id, biome) |> 
      left_join(asvs_for_tree |> distinct(asv_id, Group, label = name))
  ) |> 
  bind_rows(.id = 'trophic') |> 
  mutate(biome = factor(biome, levels = c('Mediterranean', 'Atlantic', 'Not clustered')))

asv_per_group <- 
  asv_data_for_trees |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  distinct(asv_id, Group) |> 
  count(Group) |> 
  deframe()

groups_to_trophic <- 
  asv_summaries |> 
  bind_rows(.id = 'trophic') |> 
  distinct(Group, trophic)

groups_for_fig6 <- 
  c('Prymnesiophyceae', 'MAST-3')

asvs_occurrence_trees <- 
  groups_for_fig6 |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ asv_data_for_trees |> 
      ungroup() |> 
      filter(Group == .x) |> 
      select(label, cluster2, perc2, n) # |> 
  )

asvs_nprofiles_trees <- 
  groups_for_fig6 |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ nprofiles_per_biome |> 
      ungroup() |> 
      filter(Group == .x) |> 
      select(label, biome, n)
  )
```

#### Export fasta files to tree

```{r}
order_trees |> 
  walk(
    ~ asvs_for_tree |> 
      filter(Group == .x) |> 
      select(name, ASV) |> 
      bind_rows(add_outgroup(group = .x, n = 5)) |> 
      deframe() |> 
      Biostrings::DNAStringSet() |> 
      Biostrings::writeXStringSet(str_c('../data/trees/fasta/',.x,'.fasta'))
  )
```

#### Process trees

```{r}
rooted_trees <- 
  tree_files |> 
  purrr::map(root_tree_at_outgroup)

final_trees <- 
  tree_files |> 
  purrr::map(remove_outgroup)  
```

### Figure 3

```{r}
fig3a <- 
  clusterer_and_plotter_occur(
      n_clusters = clusters_per_profile$pico,
      phy_table = phy_tables$pico,
      cluster_names = cluster_names$pico,
      min_occur = 1,
      metadata_df = metadata_df,
      plot_membership = F,
      ncol = 7
    ) +
  theme(legend.position = 'top') + 
  labs(y = 'Depth (m)')

fig3b <- 
   clusterer_and_plotter_occur(
      n_clusters = clusters_per_profile$photo,
      phy_table = phy_tables$photo,
      cluster_names = cluster_names$photo,
      min_occur = 1,
      metadata_df = metadata_df,
      plot_membership = F,
      ncol = 7
    ) +
  guides(color = 'none', fill = 'none') + 
  labs(y = 'Depth (m)')

fig3c <- 
   clusterer_and_plotter_occur(
      n_clusters = clusters_per_profile$phago,
      phy_table = phy_tables$phago,
      cluster_names = cluster_names$phago,
      min_occur = 1,
      metadata_df = metadata_df,
      plot_membership = F,
      ncol = 7
    ) +
  guides(color = 'none', fill = 'none') + 
  labs(x = 'Relative read abundance (%)', y = 'Depth (m)')

fig3 <- 
  wrap_plots(fig3a, fig3b, fig3c, ncol = 1) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

ggsave(plot = fig3, filename = '../figures/fig3.pdf', height = 14, width = 10)
```

```{r}
p_cluster_summaries <-
  cluster_summaries[c('pico','photo')] |>
  imap(
    ~ distr_clusters_plotter(group = .y, cluster_summary = .x)

ggsave(
```

```{r}
asv_occurrence_per_layer <- 
  order_trees |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(
    ~ asv_data_for_trees |> 
      ungroup() |> 
      arrange(cluster2) |> 
      filter(Group == .x) |> 
      select(label, cluster2, n) |> 
      pivot_wider(names_from = label, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |> 
      column_to_rownames('cluster2')
  )
  
matched_data <- 
  order_trees |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(~ match.phylo.comm(rooted_trees[[.x]], asv_occurrence_per_layer[[.x]]))

phylo_distances <- 
  order_trees |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(~ cophenetic(matched_data[[.x]]$phy))

null_models <- 
  set_names(rep('independentswap', length(order_trees)), order_trees)

null_models[["Kathablepharidacea"]] <- 'taxa.labels' # getting stuck with independentswap

set.seed(123)

ses_mntd_results <-
  order_trees |>
  set_names() |>
  map(
    ~ ses.mntd(
      samp = matched_data[[.x]]$comm,
      dis = phylo_distances[[.x]],
      null.model = null_models[[.x]]
      )
  )

ses_mpd_results <-
  order_trees |>
  set_names() |>
  map(
    ~ ses.mpd(
      samp = matched_data[[.x]]$comm,
      dis = phylo_distances[[.x]],
      null.model = null_models[[.x]]
    )
  )

table2 <- 
  ses_mntd_results |> 
  map(
    ~ .x |> 
      as_tibble(rownames = 'Clusters')
  ) |> 
  bind_rows(.id = 'Groups') |> 
  select(Groups, Clusters, ntaxa, mntd.obs.z, mntd.obs.p) |> 
  left_join(
    ses_mpd_results |> 
    map(
      ~ .x |> 
        as_tibble(rownames = 'Clusters')
    ) |> 
    bind_rows(.id = 'Groups') |> 
    select(Groups, Clusters, ntaxa, mpd.obs.z, mpd.obs.p) 
  )

write_tsv(table2, '../tables/table2.tsv')
```

### Table S2

```{r}
clusters_summary_nasvs <-
  clusters_df |>
  map(
    ~ .x |>
      select(-profile_abb) |> 
      left_join(profiles_abb) |> 
      mutate(
        cluster =
          case_when(
            str_detect(cluster_name, "Deep|Above") ~ str_remove(cluster_name, "[12]"), # unify duplicated layers into one
            is.na(cluster_name) ~ cluster,
            TRUE ~ cluster_name
          )
      ) |>
      mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = c("Surface", "Above", "DCM", "Below", "Deep", "low_membership", "low_abundance"))) |> 
      distinct(asv_id, profile_abb, cluster) |> 
      count(profile_abb, cluster) |> 
      arrange(cluster) |> 
      pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |> 
      rowwise() |> 
      mutate(TOTAL = sum(c_across(Surface:low_abundance))) |>
      dplyr::rename(Stations = profile_abb, `No cluster` = low_membership, `NA <0.01%` = low_abundance) |> 
      arrange(Stations) |> 
      select(Stations, TOTAL, everything())
  ) |> 
  bind_rows(.id = 'Dataset') |> 
  rename_with(.cols = -c(Stations, Dataset, TOTAL), ~ str_c(.x,'_nasvs'))

clusters_summary_reads <- 
  clusters_df |>
  map(
    ~ .x |>
      select(-profile_abb) |> 
      left_join(profiles_abb) |> 
      mutate(
        cluster =
          case_when(
            str_detect(cluster_name, "Deep|Above") ~ str_remove(cluster_name, "[12]"), # unify duplicated layers into one
            is.na(cluster_name) ~ cluster,
            TRUE ~ cluster_name
          )
      ) |>
      mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = c("Surface", "Above", "DCM", "Below", "Deep", "low_membership", "low_abundance"))) |> 
      group_by(profile_abb, cluster, sample) |> 
      summarise(perc = sum(perc), .groups = 'drop_last') |> 
      summarise(perc = mean(perc)) |> 
      arrange(cluster) |> 
      pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = perc, values_fill = 0) |> 
      dplyr::rename(Stations = profile_abb, `No cluster` = low_membership, `NA <0.01%` = low_abundance)
  )  |> 
  bind_rows(.id = 'Dataset') |> 
  rename_with(.cols = -c(Stations, Dataset), ~ str_c(.x,'_perc'))

tableS2 <- 
  clusters_summary_nasvs |> 
  left_join(clusters_summary_reads)

write_tsv(tableS2, '../tables/tableS2.tsv')
```

### Table S3

```{r}
cluster_summaries_clean <- 
  cluster_summaries |> 
  imap(
    ~ {
          n_layers <- if_else(.y == 'phago',2,3) 
          .x |> 
          ungroup() |> 
          select(profile_abb, Group, perc, layer) |> 
          filter(layer %in% c('Surface','DCM','Deep')) |> 
          arrange(layer) |> 
          mutate(layer = fct_inorder(as.character(layer))) |> 
          group_by(Group) |> 
          filter(n_distinct(layer) == n_layers) # avoid having empty layers for a given group
      }
  )

cluster_stat_test <- 
  cluster_summaries_clean |> 
  imap(~ {
    n_layers <- n_distinct(.x$layer)
    
    if (n_layers == 2) {
      # Run Wilcoxon test for 2-layer sets
      .x |> 
        group_by(Group) |> 
        reframe(broom::tidy(wilcox.test(perc ~ layer))) |> 
        mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
      
    } else if (n_layers >= 3) {
      # Run Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn test for 3-layer sets
      run_kruskal_dunn(.x)
    }
  })

supergroups <- 
  tax_table(phy_table_pico) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  distinct(Group, Supergroup)

tableS3 <- 
  cluster_summaries_all |> 
  imap(~ {
    n_layers <- n_distinct(.x$layer)
    
    order_groups <- 
      .x |>
      group_by(Group) |>
      summarise(total = sum(mean_perc)) |>
      arrange(-total) |>
      pull(Group)
    
    if (n_layers == 2) {
        .x |> 
        left_join(supergroups) |>
        pivot_wider(names_from = layer, values_from = mean_perc, values_fill = 0) |> 
        mutate(Average = mean(c_across(Surface:Deep), na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
        left_join(cluster_stat_test[[.y]] |> select(Group, p.adj)) |> 
        mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = order_groups)) |> 
        arrange(Group)
      
    } else if (n_layers >= 3) {
      .x |> 
        left_join(supergroups) |>
        pivot_wider(names_from = layer, values_from = mean_perc, values_fill = 0) |> 
        mutate(Average = mean(c_across(Surface:Deep), na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
        left_join(
          cluster_stat_test[[.y]]$kruskal |> 
            select(Group, p.adj)
        ) |> 
        left_join(
          cluster_stat_test[[.y]]$dunn |> 
            select(Group, Comparison, P.adj) |> 
            pivot_wider(names_from = Comparison, values_from = P.adj)
          ) |> 
        mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = order_groups)) |> 
        arrange(Group)
    }
  }
  ) |> 
  bind_rows(.id = 'Dataset')

write_tsv(tableS3, '../tables/tableS3.tsv')
```
